comment: The single source of truth for which Grafana dashboards exist and who owns them.
publish.sh, gen_dashboards.py and the README all read this file. Add a dashboard
here and nowhere else. gen_dashboards.py reports anything live in Grafana that is
missing from this list, so drift surfaces instead of accumulating.
Each entry records its folder and tags; gen_dashboards.py reports any that drift.
managed   generated from this repo and published by publish.sh
adopt     SOMA-specific, live, but not yet generated here
retire    safe to delete; kept listed so the decision is recorded
stock     provisioned by Grafana Cloud or an integration; leave alone

dashboards.title: SOMA Engineering
dashboards.note: HTTP, routes, dependencies, workflow spans, database load, telemetry pipeline.

dashboards.title: SOMA Operations
dashboards.note: Webhook receipt and processing. Single page on purpose: an operator dashboard should hide nothing behind a tab.

dashboards.title: SOMA Workflow Health
dashboards.note: One tab per business workflow, overview first. Adding a workflow adds 8 panels automatically.

dashboards.title: Supabase — Soma (corrected)
dashboards.note: Good curated USE coverage of Postgres and poolers, far better than the 127-panel stock integration board. Bring its generator into this repo.

dashboards.title: Soma Metrics
dashboards.note: Superseded by soma-engineering. Its business tiles (Tivly leads, Quotes submitted, Submission flows) render 0 in green, which reads as healthy when the truth is not-measured. Retire or fix; do not leave as is.

dashboards.title: Alert Groups Insights
dashboards.note: Grafana IRM. Renders empty until alerts fire and an incident process exists. Cannot be moved out of the root: Grafana rejects the write with "Cannot save provisioned dashboard".

dashboards.title: Incident Insights
dashboards.note: Grafana IRM. Renders empty until alerts fire and an incident process exists. Cannot be moved out of the root: Grafana rejects the write with "Cannot save provisioned dashboard".

dashboards.title: MacOS / logs
dashboards.note: Logs from the Angie Mac host.

dashboards.title: MacOS / overview
dashboards.note: The Angie Mac host. Its node_* series are macOS volumes, so they do not describe Supabase's disk.

dashboards.title: Metrics endpoint scrape overview
dashboards.note: Scrape health for the Supabase metrics endpoint.

dashboards.title: Supabase Project
dashboards.note: Grafana Cloud Supabase integration, 127 panels, mostly generic node_exporter series. soma-supabase covers the same ground with 29 curated panels.
